title: 水滴成核
audience: 喜欢高质感视觉广告的年轻观众
visual_style: 无人物产品微距广告，真实咖啡粉、冷水、深色冷萃液、透明玻璃瓶，克制商业摄影，连续物理变化，禁止模型生成文字和Logo

shots.story_beat: 干粉接受冷水并形成第一块湿润区域
shots.attention_subject: 咖啡粉层与第一滴冷水
shots.subject_action: 冷水滴落、渗透咖啡粉层、湿润斑块扩大、液滴聚结形成连续深色咖啡液面
shots.continuity_out: 液面边缘的连续波动匹配下一镜瓶口液体
shots.generation_prompt: Internal shot timeline / 15 seconds / one continuous macro take / 9:16 product film. Subject lock: real coffee grounds and one stream of cold water, no people. 0-3s: dry coffee grounds in macro detail, individual grains and texture visible. 3-7s: one cold water drop falls from above and enters the grounds; water visibly wicks between grains and creates a dark wet patch. 7-11s: the wet patch expands; grounds absorb water, darken, and gather into small liquid beads. 11-15s: beads merge into a continuous dark coffee liquid surface with a small natural ripple. Camera path: vertical overhead macro, slow push-in following the water and wet patch, no cut and no jump. Continuity lock: same grounds, same water, same vessel, same lighting throughout; do not introduce a new object. Final 3 seconds hold the continuous dark coffee liquid surface stable. First frame: dry coffee grounds. Last frame: continuous dark coffee liquid surface. Never show: people, dialogue, text, logo, abstract shapes, blocks, decorative geometry, random particles, sudden bottle. Only real grounds, water, wetting, merging, and coffee liquid.
acceptance_tests: 具体可见粉层、水滴、湿润区域和咖啡液面

shots.story_beat: 咖啡液从液面连续进入成品瓶并完成产品英雄收束
shots.attention_subject: 深褐色咖啡液与透明玻璃瓶
shots.subject_action: 液流沿瓶口进入、液面上升、冷凝水出现、瓶身稳定呈现
shots.generation_prompt: Internal shot timeline / 15 seconds / one continuous macro-to-product take / 9:16 product film. Subject lock: the same dark coffee liquid from the previous shot and one transparent glass bottle, no people. 0-3s: continue from the previous dark liquid edge; camera follows one real stream downward into the bottle opening. 3-7s: liquid level visibly rises inside the glass, remaining dark coffee with realistic refraction. 7-11s: camera slowly orbits the bottle as condensation beads form on the glass and slide downward. 11-15s: liquid stops rising; the full bottle is clear and stable in the center as a product hero. Camera path: follow the liquid stream down, then slow half-orbit around the bottle, no cut. Continuity lock: same coffee liquid, same bottle, same lighting and direction from the previous shot; no replacement object. Final 4 seconds hold the finished bottle stable for brand overlay in post. First frame: the same dark liquid stream entering the bottle. Last frame: stable transparent bottle filled with dark cold brew and real condensation. Never show: people, dialogue, generated text, logo, abstract shapes, blocks, decorative geometry, random particles, liquid morphing into an unrelated object, garbled label. Only real liquid, glass, condensation and light.
acceptance_tests: 无方块和随机抽象转化
